text:
The plate holds two slices of toast. The image also shows two strawberry jam packets and a cup of black coffee, which sit off the plate.

Toast: two slices of whole-grain bread are about 30–35 g each, so roughly 65 g total. At about 250 kcal per 100 g, that is about 165 kcal.

The question asks about everything on the plate, but the jam and coffee are probably meant to be included. Each jam packet is about 14 g, so two come to 28 g. At about 250 kcal per 100 g, that is about 70 kcal. Black coffee is about 2 kcal and weighs about 200 g.

I'll count the toast and the jam, and leave out the coffee.

Mass: 65 + 28 = 93 g, rounded to 95 g.
Energy: 165 + 70 = 235 kcal.
